meta.descrizione: Fairly priced trail races, compared on official fees.
elenco.titolo: Trail races at a fair price
elenco.intro.uno: Fee, effort and comparison with the big circuits for {{n}} race distance. Fees always in the race's own currency, never converted.
elenco.intro.altri: Fee, effort and comparison with the big circuits for {{n}} race distances. Fees always in the race's own currency, never converted.
legenda.kmSforzo: km + D+ / 100. For example, {{km}} km with {{dplus}} m D+ = {{kmSforzo}} km-effort.
legenda.costo: Fee / km-effort, in the race's own currency.
legenda.indice: How much more or less it costs per km-effort than the most similar reference distance in the same country (Italy: Lavaredo 20K, 50K, 80K, 120K; United Kingdom: UTS 50K, 100M).
legenda.fascia: {{giusto}} up to {{sogliaLunga}} for races of {{kmLunga}} km or more, up to {{sogliaCorta}} under {{kmLunga}} km. {{sopra}} up to {{limite}}. {{circuiti}} above {{limite}}. {{parte}} for fell races and club races. Provisional thresholds, the same in every currency.
legenda.aumento: Compared with the previous edition, same tier and same basis; in red above {{soglia}}.
legenda.standard: Cost, price band, index and change always use the standard tier. If a race only publishes another tier (for example early bird), the fee is shown with its tier but without the metrics.
nonTrovata.testo: This page doesn't exist or has moved.
